title: RAG golden-set item
description: One frozen question/ground-truth item for the prometheus-eval harness (RAGAS + DeepEval). Field names mirror ragas' EvaluationDataset column names (user_input, reference_contexts, reference, retrieved_contexts, response) so items load into ragas.EvaluationDataset.from_list() and deepeval.test_case.LLMTestCase with no reshaping.

id.description: Stable id, e.g. rag-config-001. Never reused, never renumbered after freeze.

category.description: One of the 5 intents the full 300-item set is stratified across (analysis.md 4.5).

user_input.description: The question posed to the RAG system under test. Matches ragas' `user_input` column.

reference_contexts.description: Ground-truth source passages the retriever SHOULD surface for this question (used for context_precision/context_recall). Verbatim excerpts from the cited `source` file, not paraphrased.

reference.description: The ground-truth answer (ragas' `reference` column / DeepEval's `expected_output`), hand-verified against `source` at curation time.

source.description: Repo-relative path (+ optional line range) the reference_contexts and reference were verified against, e.g. 'docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#L47' or 'src/uar/rag/retrieval.rs'.

difficulty.description: easy = single-fact lookup; medium = requires combining 2 passages; hard = multi-hop or requires disambiguating near-duplicate config keys.

notes.description: Optional curator notes: why this item is interesting, known retriever traps, etc.

frozen_at.description: ISO date this item was frozen. Items are append-only after freeze; a correction is a new id with the old id tombstoned in CHANGELOG.md, never an in-place edit (done-condition: 'frozen golden set... version-controlled').
